S.FORM: == sapaculi tu Tukiw 東京卍復仇者 == kakungkuan 故事大綱 kalingatuan 開端 ci Hua-tan-u-taw makamilaw tu naayaway a mamidang ci Ci-ze-sing-ci-ci milab utu "Tuke卍kaput"tun卍 nikalalebuaan a mapatay nu sinwengan, kilul sa tu nikahetikan nida i dadan nu silamalay masimsim nida tu nipicudad tu Kuocung tusaay a mihcaan, tiayawan nida musakamu ci nida sakatayni anu ayaw, cima ku matunengay hedek sa musakamu makakamel ku lima', ci U-taw taluma'tu tusepcaypic mihcaan nu ayda, ku mamapatyay a tademaw ci Ce-zen malakincal a tahekal. ci Ce-zen miuningay ci U-tawan taluma' tu tusepseplim mihcaan, miput tu tun卍 naw hinadebitay a tademaw malalumuwa a " Cuo-ye-wan-ce-lang" aci "Si-cen-te-tay" malalikelun. . ci U-taw mibetas, masasutineng aci Tun卍sakakaay ci Wang-ce'-lang aci Lung-kun-se-cin, matapal nida caay kaw la'cusay a tademaw, atu makatalay ci Tun卍, aydaaay amikilim tu sakatineng tu tawyaay i Lun-ku miyuan anikapatay nu nikalalebuan nu Tun卍. . kacinlawan peizi 鬥爭篇 katukuh ci U-taw tu tusepseplim mihcaan, ci Tun卍mangalay paculi ci " aymei-aycu" a nikalingatu a malalebu, amica ku nikakaci, nika ci Tun卍idaw ku nidikecan tu katini' mipacuk tu aymei-aycu nu sakakaay, sadikuday mihang aku ku mipatayay sa, ci Wang-ce'-lang aci Lung-kun-se saemaema sa. ci U-taw milawlaw tu nikasasungaay nu heni a tatusa, mangalay misudikud tu aymei-aycu masakaputay atu ci Tun卍, midebung tu i walu bulad tulu demiad tu Lung-kun-se', nika ina Lung-kun-se' kaidawan ni U-taw sa maala. mutiku tu ayda, masumad tu ku dui't, ci Ze'-sing maudip aca, nika caay ka tenes ci Ze'-sing idaw ku nipikiyakuan ni Tun卍 nu sakasizikuan a mapatay. ci U-taw matineng tu ci Lung-kun-se'-cin malamamapatay i papululan, u cumi nida u tapang namin ku mituu'ay. 武道至2005年, . tanuidang nu wang-sen-cie 血腥萬聖節篇 yu mahida ci U-taw namiawda tu "pa-liw-pa'-luo" mamiwawies, ci Tun 卍namicunus tu icelang sapabeli ci Yen-ay-mei-ay-cu nu si-siaw malacen-hun kaput nu sakakaay. yi-fan sakakaay ci Cen-ti-kuy-cie mibelih tayda ci Pa-liw-pa'-luoan, sakatusa nu sakakaay ci Sun-ye-cin-tun saan musakamu, ci Cen-ti u taydaay malasepay u mamikilim ci Si-siwan nu minikudanay a siwmian. ci U-taw matineng tu anikalepacawan : malumanay ni Tun卍a tademaw ci Yi-kun-yi-hu pacuk han nida ci Cen-ti, ci Wang-ce'-lang amipaty ci Yi-huan, ci Si-siaw milinikudan tu patay malasakakaay. tusa malebut mihcaan cacay a bataan bulad tulu a bataan idaw ku cacay nu demiad, mi'ten ci nida tu nikasikawawan, sadikuday mapatay tu ci Cen-ti, nika ci Yi-hu caay ka patay, maala ni U-taw. . sa ci U-taw malayi-hun kaput nu sakakaay, mutiku aca tayni tu aydaay ci Tun卍malasakakaay tu, saan ku tadasakakaay ci Si-siaw tu ci U-taw, Cin-tun u sepay ku nu heni sa, tusepcaypic mihcaan caycay bulad caywal demiad, kuwangen ni Si-siaw ci Cin-tun, mahka tahekalay namaka papululan nanay ci Yi-hu alaen nida ci U-taw, saan ci Yi-hu malacaculculen ci U-taw sa, tiiken setulen tukuden a maynah ci U-taw, sakamu han ci U-taw amana pisakuakuay han, ci U-taw palita han ni Yi-hu tu aydaay nida a kawaw, misuayaw tu la'cusay a tademaw ci Mikey, sakamu han ni U-taw ci Tun卍 ci Si-siaw atu ci Yen-hei-lung misakaput sa masumad, mangalay tu a edapan ni U-taw. ,對於Mikey的極惡, . masikad ci U-taw tuci Tun卍ngan, saan cu nida ku mipatayay ci Ci-tungan, sakamusa ci Yi-hu ci Si-siaw ku mipatayay tu ci Cin-tungan a lalekalan u ci Cin-tun kina paciciay. ci Yi-hu alaen nida ci U-taw patayda ci Ce-zenan, nika ci Ce-zen amidakep ci U-tawan, sakasaan kainayi'an nu lahecian ayda ni U-taw mangalay cidida tu ku mipatayay ci Ci-ze-sin'gan. sadikuday ci U-taw masasukamel ku lima misetul aca katuku tu tusepseplim mihcaan. ci U-taw micucucu ci Yi-hu, Cin-tun tu nitungihan, paytemsa ci nida a bahbahen ci Si-siaw aci Yen-hei-lun-cu patayda ci Tun卍ngan, mahinikya caay ka hidasa nayi' ku laheci. ,這樣Mikey才不會墮落下去. pikulisimasean nu nikalepacawan peizi 聖夜決戰篇 ci U-taw mutiku aca tayda tu tusepseplim mihcaan maadih nida nu miliyasay ci Tun卍 a Cay-pa-cie, yamipatayay tu kaka ci Hei-lung sakakaay ci Cay-ta-suo nipiladay nida milabu tina Hei-lung Tun 卍. saan palaheci ci Cin-tun tu nipibetasan a kawawan, misuayaw ayda ci Cin-tun tu sakapaty ni U-taw, misuayaw ci Pa-cie-yi mipatayay a kaka mamiala tu nisawacuan a kaka ci Yiu-yean, simata tu nuhenian aci Hei-lung tu nikakapahan a cudadan, itini satu i sasa a miput tu nu henian. tusepseplim mihcaan sabaw tusa bulad tusa a bataan idaw ku lima demiad, ci Si-siaw aci Pan-cin paceba manglay a miedap, ci U-taw nu tademaw aci Hei-lun masasuad, tatengaay nu mipatayay a tademaw ci Yiu-ye itini tu a mipatay nika caay ka laheci, sadikuday ci Wang-ce'-lang tayda kitidaan misupit ci Ta-suoan. . mademec tu kaku sa ci Hei-lung, milaylayay ci Cin, Ciw-cin sakamusa milab utu Tun卍, ci Si-siaw papabelien ci U-siaw-tau tu katini' mipacuk ci Tun卍 pasu ci Lin-pan-ci. Si-saiw lawpesen ni Mikey ku ngangan ni Tun卍, palasikian tu ci Tun 卍 nu tusaay a siicelangay hida satu makaykic, baluhay a mihcaan ci U-taw mutikuaca tayni tu aydaay, maadih nida ci Pu-tan siziku mapaty, u masakaputay ni Tun卍matulin a mapatay, ya mipatayay han ci Wan-ce'-lan. ci Wan-ce'-lang miawda ci U-tawan patayen ci nida sa, tunika lalebuan nina tatusaay ci Ce-zen sipakay tapiingan a mikuwang ci Wan-ce'-langan, paytem satu ci U-taw amiala tu katuuday sisa misetul aca milakuuyt tu naayaway tu tusepseplim mihcaan. Mikey 2005年. Ten-cu peizi 天竺篇 tusepsepnem a Heng-pin nu masakaputay "Ten-cu" midebung ci Tun卍ngan, ci U-taw makatengil tu kamu nida i Ten-cuay a cabayen ci He'-tei sakamusa ku sakakaay ci Hei-cuan- yi-cuo cukaymasen ni Si-siaw sa. makatukuh ci U-taw tu aydaay mamikilim tu zingbuan lalikeluh sa aci Cay-ta-seo, sakamu han nida cini U-taw aci Ce-zen tu tawyaay nu mihcaan a kawawan " kun-tun-se-pen" nu hedek u Ten-cu aci Tun卍nikalepacawan a mapulung, u sakakaay han ci Wan-ce'-lang, kilul sa ci Si-siaw, Yi-cuo-na, nikudan sa ci Tun卍malasicumiay nu masakaputay. 2006 . masasakamu ku nu heni ci Tun卍 a tademaw manglay a midakep ci U-taw zi Ce-zen, ya tatusaay kuwang han mapatay, ci U-taw aci pihacengay nu dukaan ci Ce-zen makakamel tu lima setul satu. aitida tu Hei-lung patideng tu demiadan nu tusa a buald tusa a bataan idaw ku tusa dimiadan tuya labiyi a masasetset, duma a tapiingan ci Si-siaw patayen nida ci Ay-ma, mahiniay nu caayay a lemed ci Wan-ce'-lang Lung-kun-se' naynayi tu ku laheci, macunus ni Tun卍 nu tusaay a sakakaay sidepan a maduka, ci U-fan kaput ku mihantayay, duma a tademaw ku caay pilihida a milepacaw, nika nikaydaan ni U-taw aci Ci-tun nu nikalawlawan, hida sat uku katuuday. ci Ze-sin misuayaw ci Wan-ce'-lan aci Lung-kun-se' patahekalan nida ku kakawaw ni U-taw, sa hida satu ku nu heni tatulu a malalebu, sadikuday ci Yi-cuo-na tu nikalalebuan mademec ni Wan-ce'-lang, sa ala han ci He-tei patayen naca ci Si-siaw a mipatay, ci Si-saiw han tu nika zikuan a mapatay. . tulu a demiad a nikalepacawan peizi 三天戰爭篇 taluma' tu tawyaay ci U-taw itida i aci Ze'-sin pikikungan kuwangen patayen ni MLKEY, ci MLKEY mangalay tu nipiala mibetas aca tayda tu caca nu bataan. tusepsepwal mihcaan pitu bulad pitu demiad, Kun-tun 卍 atu tuluay nu kaputan makaci. tusepsepwal mihcaan siwa bulad siwa demiad, ci U-taw mililid tu E-tay-mu-tun-cin卍midademec tu MLKEYnu Kun-tun卍sa pacuken tu katini'. sadikuday ci MIKEY aci U-taw tatusa mibetas aca katukuh tu wawa nu zitayan, misumad ci Si-siaw atu katuuday tu nikasasuadaan.
